source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Sum 1 to n = n(n+1)/2. Sum of the first 8 odd numbers = 8² = 64.
bullets.ne: 1 देखि n सम्मको योग = n(n+1)/2। पहिलो 8 बिजोरको योग = 8² = 64।

bullets.en: Quadratic formula: x = (−b ± √(b²−4ac)) ÷ 2a. x²−25x+154 = 0 → roots 11 and 14.
2×2 determinant: |A| = ad − bc; trace = a + d. For [[11,10],[2,4]]: |A| = 24, trace = 15.
Train crossing: time = (train + platform) ÷ speed. 36 km/h = 10 m/s (×5/18). 180 m + 240 m at 10 m/s = 42 s.
Triangle area = ½×b×h: base 8, height 12 → 48 cm². Circle: πr².
bullets.ne: त्रिभुज क्षेत्रफल = ½×आधार×उचाइ: 8, 12 → 48 cm²। वृत्त: πr²।

bullets.en: Derivative: d/dx(xⁿ) = n·xⁿ⁻¹. For x³+34x²−4x+7: f′(2) = 144, f″(2) = 80.
bullets.ne: अवकलज: d/dx(xⁿ) = n·xⁿ⁻¹। x³+34x²−4x+7 का लागि: f′(2) = 144, f″(2) = 80।

bullets.en: Log rules: log(ab) = log a + log b; log(aⁿ) = n·log a.
bullets.ne: लग नियम: log(ab) = log a + log b; log(aⁿ) = n·log a।

bullets.en: Permutations: nPr = n!/(n−r)!. Combinations: nCr = n!/(r!(n−r)!).
bullets.ne: क्रमचय: nPr = n!/(n−r)!। संयोजन: nCr = n!/(r!(n−r)!)।

bullets.en: Mean = average; median = middle value; mode = most frequent value.
bullets.ne: माध्य = औसत; मध्यक = बीचको मान; बहुलक = सबैभन्दा बढी पटक।
